component.name: Samba file server
component.summary: Cockpit extension to manage a Samba file server

description.p: A Cockpit extension that manages smb.conf (global settings, shares and any other parameter), Samba users, the smbd and nmbd services, connected clients and logs. Every change is checked with testparm, shown as a diff, backed up and applied with a configuration reload. Comments and unknown parameters are preserved, and risky settings such as SMB1 or guest access are flagged.
